description: This file defines metrics and instrumentation for CRD conversion and webhook operations in Kubernetes, including histogram and counter metrics for conversion durations and webhook request success/failure counts.

classes.name: converterMetricFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating and managing metrics for CRD converters.

classes.name: converterMetric
classes.description: Implementation of crConverterInterface that records metrics for conversions.

classes.name: ConversionWebhookMetrics
classes.description: Struct holding metrics for webhook conversion requests and latency.

methods.name: addMetrics
methods.description: Adds or retrieves metrics for a specific CRD converter.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Records the duration of a conversion operation and updates metrics.

methods.name: newConversionWebhookMetrics
methods.description: Initializes metrics for webhook conversion requests and latency.

methods.name: ObserveConversionWebhookSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful webhook conversion request.

methods.name: ObserveConversionWebhookFailure
methods.description: Records a failed webhook conversion request with error type.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Helper to record latency metrics for webhook conversions.
